# The problem slide's numbers and map

Map of the conterminous United States, 2016-2025: one circle for each of the 146 rail accidents in which a car released hazmat, its area its reported damage (largest $15.8 million), over grey cells where any rail equipment accident happened.

## How often, and what it costs

- **All modes:** 24,265 hazmat transportation incidents were reported to PHMSA in 2023
  (`bts-tsar-2024`, PDF p.161 (printed 5-24); `docs/evidence/hb127/base_rates.tsv`). Their damage in dollars is not held:
  BTS NTS table 2-6 and the Table 5-5 workbook were refused to the fetcher (HB-127, rung 2).
- **Rail, where a car released hazmat:** 146 accidents in 2016-2025, 14.6 a
  year on average, with $209.5 million of reported damage to equipment and track
  ($20.9 million a year on average; dollars as reported, not adjusted for
  inflation; FRA Form 54 Blocks 36 and 37, each accident counted once).

| Year | Rail accidents releasing hazmat | Reported damage, million dollars |
|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 14 | 24.1 |
| 2017 | 13 | 18.9 |
| 2018 | 20 | 16.7 |
| 2019 | 15 | 19.5 |
| 2020 | 20 | 31.9 |
| 2021 | 13 | 29.0 |
| 2022 | 13 | 17.3 |
| 2023 | 12 | 16.9 |
| 2024 | 11 | 15.3 |
| 2025 | 15 | 19.9 |

## The map

`docs/incidents/problem_us_damage.svg`: one mark per place (146 places), its area proportional to the place's reported damage, one
colour, a scale key, and the source and years beneath. The ground is HB-136R's 71 km cells holding any Form 54
accident; the United States' outline is not held. 1 accident reported no damage and is drawn
at the smallest size. The line under the map:

Source: FRA Form 6180.54 rail equipment accidents (fra-form54-rail-equipment-accidents), 2016-2025: the 146 accidents in which a car released hazmat, at their reported coordinates. Mark area: reported damage to equipment and track (Blocks 36 and 37), dollars as reported. Grey: 71 km cells with any rail equipment accident. Highway, air and water releases (PHMSA 5800.1) are not held.
